name: Darializa Avila Chevalier
desc: American politician from New York City
summary:
Darializa Avila Chevalier (born 1993 or 1994), also known as DAC, is an American politician and community organizer who is the U.S. representative-elect for New York's 13th congressional district. She is a member of the Democratic Party and the Democratic Socialists of America.
Born and raised in Florida, Avila Chevalier moved to New York City in 2012 to study at Columbia College, where she received a Bachelor of Arts in Middle Eastern studies.
